<entry id="B00751">
<head-word>בי"ת</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>Beth</italic>, the second letter of the Alphabeth.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup> top; a. fr.; v. אל"ף.—Y. Ned. III, 38

<plural-form>Pl. בֵּיתִין</plural-form>. Sabb. 103

<sup>a</sup> מיא דביתו (Chald. transl. of the ambiguous מים שֶׁלָּנוּ) water kept in vessels over night. Ber. 60
<sup>b</sup> בת בדברא he slept in the open field. Snh. 63
<sup>b</sup>.—Ib. 109
<sup>a</sup> top בעי למֵיבַת he wanted to stay over night; a. e.—Part. בָּאֵית. Targ. Is. LVIII, 5.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="B00753">
<head-word>בַּיִת</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> cmp. preced.; v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. as to various etymological attempts), constr.</definition>
<notes> בֵּית, 
<plural-form>pl. בָּתִּים</plural-form>. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>house, household, home</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 11
<sup>b</sup> ב' מיוחד לדירה 
<pgbrk id="pg168" />
<italic>bayith</italic> means a building intended for a dwelling. Ib. מי שמייחד ביתו לו (Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he who devotes his house (its contents) to himself exclusively (unaccommodating); Arakh. 16
<sup>a</sup> מי שמיוחד וכ'.—בעל הב' (abbrev. בע"ה) 
<italic>owner, landlord; host; private man</italic>, opp. to trader, artisan &c. Ber. 46
<sup>a</sup> בע"ה בוצע וכ' the host breaks the bread, and the guest says the blessing. Tosef. ib. IV, 14 של בע"ה home-made (bread), opp. גלוסקין; Y. ib. VI, 10
<sup>b</sup> bot.—Sabb. I, 1 בע"ה the donor, opp. עני the recipient. Gen. R. s. 22; a. v. fr.—בן ב' 
<italic>inmate, attendant.</italic> Ab. I, 5; a. fr.—פסול הב' the degraded (slave) of the house. Gen. R. s. 70.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> Esp. (הַ)בַּ' 
<italic>the Temple</italic>.</definition>
<notes> בפני הב' in days when the Temple exists, שלא בפני הב' when it does not exist. Ḥull. V, 1; a. fr.—ב' שני or ב' אחרון 
<italic>the Second Temple</italic>. Cant. R. to VIII, 9; a. fr.—הר הב' Temple Mount, v. הַר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>school, college</italic>, (collect.) 
<italic>disciples;</italic> בֵּית הלל Hillelites &c. Bets. I, 1; a. fr. Treat. Sof’rim IV, 1 של ב' וכ' those of the house of &c. [Y.</definition>
<notes> Shebi. II, 33
<sup>d</sup> bot., a. e. דבית … ר', usu. דבי, v. בֵּי].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>body</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 44
<sup>b</sup> אוי לו לב' וכ' that human body (Rashi: stomach) is to be pitied where vegetables are a constant guest (being the only food).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>wife.</italic></definition>
<notes> Yoma I, 1 ביתו זו וכ' ‘his house’—that means his wife. Ib. 13
<sup>a</sup> והך לאו ביתו היא but this one (designated for him in case of his wife’s death) cannot be called ‘his house’. Sabb. 118
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—6)</number>
<definition> Euphem. 
<italic>pudenda; marital intercourse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. IX, 12
<sup>a</sup> top; Mikv. VIII, 4 שמשה את בֵּיתָהּ she had intercourse. Ib. כבדה את הב' she washed &c. Y. Sot. I, 16
<sup>c</sup> bot. אסורה לביתה is forbidden to her husband. Nidd. 5
<sup>a</sup> מהומת לביתה she hastens to perform her marital duty. Y. ib. I, beg. 48
<sup>d</sup>. Cmp. חֶדֶר.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—7)</number>
<definition>
<italic>store-house, store-room</italic>.</definition>
<notes> בֵּית העצים wood-room; ב' התבן straw-magazine; ב' הבקר stable; &c. Yoma 11
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—8)</number>
<definition> (geogr.) 
<italic>place, town</italic>, in compounds (for which see the respective determinants), e.g. ב' בוקיא Beth-Bukya &c.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—9)</number>
<definition> (anat.) 
<italic>limb, organ</italic>, in compounds (v. supra 8)), e.g. ב' הבליעה œsophagus, &c.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—10)</number>
<definition>
<italic>shed</italic> for plants, 
<italic>covering.</italic></definition>
<notes> Shebi. II, 4 (pl.). Y. ib. 33
<sup>d</sup>.—Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup>.—1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>receptacle, cover</italic> &c., e.g. ב' הדיו 
<italic>inkstand</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 11; ב' יד 
<italic>sleeve</italic>, v. אוּנְקְלַי II, &c.—Men. 34
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. 
<italic>cases of the T’fillin</italic></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Chief compounds:.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בֵּית אָב</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, pl. בָּתֵּי אָבוֹת </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>paternal home, family</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 38
<sup>a</sup> שני ב' א' two families (dynasties); a. fr.—Tosef. Ter. II, 11 בתי אבות = אריסי ב' א' 
<italic>hereditary land-tenants;</italic> B. Bath. 46
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>priest’s division.</italic></definition>
<notes> Taan. II, 6; a. fr.; v. אֱנֹושׁ pl.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>origin of a law, rule</italic> &c.; cmp. אָב II. Cant. R. to II, 4 ב' א' של הלכה the origin (principle) of a legal rule.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 29 wherever the root רעש is used, it means cessation of government, ואיזהו ב' א' שלהם וכ' and where is the origin (determining the meaning) of all of them? (Answ. Jer. LI, 29). Lev. R. s. 1, beg. מב' א' שלהן וכ' from the chief passage (Hagg. I, 13 ‘Haggai, the messenger’ &c.) we learn that prophets are called messengers (or angels).—בֵּית דִּין (abbr. ב"ד) 
<italic>court</italic>.—ב"ד של שבעים ואחד or ב"ד הגדול the Great Sanedrin of seventy one members. Snh. I, 5. Y. ib. 19
<sup>a</sup> bot.; a. fr.—ב"ד נוטה court of an odd number of judges. ב"ד שקול of an even number of judges. Snh 3
<sup>b</sup>.—ב"ד שריא a permitting court, opprobrious name of a court too lax in religious affairs. Y. Gitt. VII, 48
<sup>d</sup> top; Y. Nidd. III, 50
<sup>d</sup> bot.—[For all other compounds not self-evident, v. respective determinants.] [בית תר, v. בִּיתֵּר.—Gen. R. s. 12 בית שלו, בית של עולם, v. בִּיָּא.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>Pi.</italic> בָּתִּין, בָּתַּיָּא, בָּתֵּי. Targ. Ex. I, 21; a. v. fr.—B. Bath. 61

<sup>a</sup>, v. דַּרְתָּא.—Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup>
<italic>the case of T’fillin</italic>, v. preced. [Playful etymol. ב̇וא אי̇ת̇יב בה. Sabb. 77
<sup>b</sup>.]</notes></sense>
<sense>

<definition>
<italic>night-lodging</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. I, 3
<sup>a</sup> bot. ב' שטן (play on קטן) the first in obstinate dispute.—Gen. R. s. 91 (ref. to Gen. XLII, 37) הרי זה ב' שוטה וכ' is this a foolish first-born son! are thy children not my children? <plural-form>Pl. בְּכוֹרִים, בְּכוֹרוֹת</plural-form>. Ex. R. s. 18 בְּכוֹרֵי מצרים the first-born of Egyptian cattle; ib. מכת בכורות the plague of the first-born in Egypt; Num. R. s. 4; a. fr.—Bekh. <sup>b</sup> הבכו', read הבַּכִּירוֹת.] Ch. בּוּכְרָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
